{{Navbar-GOGPT-tracker}}
'''Fujairah F2 Integrated Water and power plant''' (2 محطة كهرباء الفجيرة إف) is an operating power station of at least 2166-megawatts (MW) in Qidfa, Fujairah, United Arab Emirates.
It is also known as Qidfa F2 Gas Power Plant, FAPCO (Fuj F2).
